version_name: The Gathering Turn and the Moving Ceiling
author: privacymage
thesis: V6 is the gathering turn: V5 answered WHAT the architecture is, V6 asks WHO, opening the model outward in the second person so the equation can be filled with data instead of estimates. Privacy is a dynamical quantity: the ceiling moves as R(t) while the archive sits still, and amnesia is the only term in the equation whose security is independent of t.

learning_path.description: Concepts in dependency order. Each step requires understanding the previous steps.

steps.one_line: Any term = 0 collapses total value. No tradeoffs between axes.
steps.teaches: Why the equation is multiplicative, not additive. This is the central structural claim.

steps.one_line: Two agents (Swordsman/Mage) that cannot access each other's domain. The First Person authorises both.
steps.teaches: Why privacy requires two agents, not one. The separation IS the privacy.

steps.one_line: I(S;M|FP) < ε*. Mutual information between agents is bounded. Proven at 95%. V6: proven in the conditional regime; Precondition 1 non-collusion, Precondition 2 fixed adversary class.
steps.teaches: The core information-theoretic guarantee. Everything else builds on this.

steps.one_line: Z/(2⁶)Z ring. D₆₄ dihedral group. neg(bnot(x)) = succ(x). The architecture has an algebraic name.
steps.teaches: The Swordsman and Mage are algebraic operations. Their composition generates the full sovereignty space.

steps.one_line: Observe → Boundary → Project → Return. One lap = one cycle. The equation executes.
steps.teaches: How the static equation becomes dynamic. The cycle is the equation in motion.

steps.one_line: Agent × Data × Inference. Collapse any one → total collapse.
steps.teaches: Separation is not one-dimensional. Three independent axes, multiplicatively gated.

steps.one_line: R_max = (C_S + C_M)/H(X) < 1. Perfect reconstruction is impossible. Proven. V6: R(t), the ceiling moves; shelf life t* = sup{t : R(t) < 1}.
steps.teaches: The adversary is guaranteed to make errors. This is not a design choice — it's information theory.

steps.one_line: 96 edges encode 64 vertices. Privacy computes on the boundary, not the interior.
steps.teaches: The exponent P^1.5 has geometric necessity. Value lives on the surface.

steps.one_line: Structural inability to recover shared origin. Topology enforces what policy only promises.
steps.teaches: The strongest form of separation. The Moon cannot choose to remember Theia.

steps.one_line: The ⿻ is the node with maximal C_B(v) in the trust graph. The value lives in the gap.
steps.teaches: The Gap is not empty. It's where the most paths cross. Brandes (2001) gives the algorithm.

steps.one_line: Sun (disclosure) → Gap (silence) → Moon (reflection) → Recursion. The human layer.
steps.teaches: The operational cycle performed by two people. Cryptography provides guarantees. Ceremony provides meaning.

steps.one_line: Sun/Earth/Moon/Human as the four-body architecture. Does not enter the equation.
steps.teaches: The architecture predates biology. Selene's Proof names the cosmological instance.

steps.one_line: R(t) = (C_S(t)+C_M(t))/H(X); capability grows, H(X) does not; every static guarantee has a shelf life t*.
steps.teaches: Why V6 is the time-dependent version: the decoder improves while the archive sits still.

steps.one_line: Policy separation compounds toward (2^N − 1)ε; amnesia caps at Nε; the gap is exponential-to-linear.
steps.teaches: The compounding literature is the model's strongest external citation, not its refutation.

steps.one_line: I(feasibility; method) > 0; a proof of feasibility prices the search; floor: LR-ZK with λ < 1 is impossible.
steps.teaches: Attestations are deadlines: every public capability proof discounts someone's migration horizon (C84).

steps.one_line: Protection+Delegation → Σ · Memory+Value → Δ · Connection+Computation → Γ; the gap is β.
steps.teaches: The lattice and the axes are one triadic primitive; the agents share exactly and only the First Person.

steps.one_line: Grade-2 forgetting = non-vanishing gluing obstruction; Grade-1 = vanishing class with withheld keys.
steps.teaches: Amnesia is the only term in the equation whose security is independent of t.
